name: How much does a luxury pool and backyard remodel cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does a luxury pool and backyard remodel cost in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: How much does a luxury pool and backyard remodel cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Los Angeles, a luxury pool and backyard remodel can vary widely because cost depends on size, slope, access, finish level, and the amount of hardscape and utility work required. A basic new gunite pool may start in the lower six figures, while premium projects with spas, custom tile, lighting, automation, fire features, outdoor kitchens, and designer hardscape can move well beyond that. Hillside lots, tight access, and structural retaining work often add major cost because they increase labor, engineering, and equipment needs. A useful estimate should break out the pool shell, finishes, equipment, decking, drainage, landscaping, utilities, and contingency. Homeowners should be cautious of very low bids that exclude permitting, electrical upgrades, or finish details, because those omissions can appear later as change orders. A clear scope sheet is the best way to compare proposals fairly and avoid budget surprises.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basic new gunite pools in Los Angeles often start around $70,000 to $110,000, while premium builds with spas, lighting, and higher-end finishes can run $110,000 to $180,000 or more. Hillside, infinity-edge, or large full-yard projects can exceed that range quickly.
